name: Kalamazoo County, MI
findings: Kalamazoo County has 989 nonprofit organizations. 403 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 300 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kalamazoo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 health care organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 67 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
